offering_description.value: Provides payment processing and merchant acquiring to financial institutions and merchants. It operates debit and digital payment networks and delivers financial software, technology outsourcing and transaction processing to businesses and government agencies.

primary_products.value: banking software; payment management software; investment administration software; pension administration software

primary_services.value: card and electronic payment processing; merchant acquiring; debit network operation; mobile payments and transfers; technology and business process outsourcing

customer_segment.value: B2B: banks, credit unions, card issuers, merchants, investment managers and pension administrators; B2G: Puerto Rico government agencies using technology and processing services; B2C: individuals using mobile payments and person-to-person transfers

end_markets.value: banking and payments; retail and e-commerce; investment and pension administration; government; consumer money transfers

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: card authorizations, electronic transfers, network usage and merchant payment acceptance; service fees: managed technology, hosting, and outsourced financial and administrative operations; licensing or royalties: use of banking, investment and pension administration software; project or contract: software implementation, integration and custom technology work
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees; licensing or royalties; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: routes payment instructions among merchants, financial institutions and networks and supplies software to financial institutions; service provider: handles merchant settlement and runs outsourced technology and back-office processes for businesses and government agencies

geography_served.value: global: Puerto Rico, the Caribbean and Latin America, including Brazil, Chile, Colombia and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: payment processing, merchant acquiring, financial software and technology outsourcing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams serving financial institutions, merchants, enterprises and government agencies; partners / resellers: banks and other financial institutions that refer merchants or offer network services to account holders; online: e-commerce payment gateways and mobile apps for payments and transfers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: payment processing and bank outsourcing subject to financial-sector oversight, data privacy rules and PCI DSS
